answer: Treat each epoch's answers as light through a prism: a public embedding model spreads them into bands by idea, and every band shares one fixed jade purse. Twenty clones run by one operator land in the same few bands and split the same purses, while a lone thinker who finds an empty band drinks from that oasis alone. Each extra clone must invent a truly new idea to earn anything, and empty bands get rarer with every one; peers audit band placement by rerunning the model.
